# commander_enterprise_role (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an enterprise role by name or ID. Returns the role's ID, name, users, and teams so you can reference them in other resources.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Enterprise role name or ID to find the role.

### Optional

- `managed_company` (String) Managed company name or ID to scope the lookup (used for API context only; not returned in the result).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the found enterprise role.
- `name` (String) Name of the found enterprise role.
- `teams` (Set of String) Teams of the found enterprise role.
- `users` (Set of String) Users of the found enterprise role.
